last_cycle_outcome: H59 ITERATE - minimal-FAS arc reclamation. THE MECHANISM IS REAL AND THE CHAMPION'S FEEDBACK ARC SET IS NOT MINIMAL. Lemma: if a backward edge (u,v) has no F-path v->u then F u {(u,v)} is acyclic and EVERY topological order of it scores >= base + w_uv, so reclamation is exactly monotone. PROTOTYPE PASSED ALL THREE with every reachability query resolved exactly (n_unknown 0/1/0): connectome 2,508 reclaimable arcs -> 84.15409511 -> 84.17169144 = +0.017596 pp (bar 0.012); microns 4,249 -> 83.24085291 -> 83.25961197 = +0.018759 pp (bar 0.002); mouse 5 -> 93.10282596 -> 93.17538326 = +0.072557 pp. A SECOND ROUND FOUND EXACTLY 0 ARCS ON ALL THREE, so the stage reaches a fixed point and CERTIFIES the arc set minimal. Heaviest reclaimable connectome arc weighs 39 of a 2,405 max, so every heavy backward edge is genuinely stuck and the whole gain is 2,221 light arcs. SCREEN: connectome PASSES at 84.17175348 = +0.017658 pp, 1.47x the bar, stage cost 457.6 s of a 1574.1 s run; and the internal control h42_best_pct = 84.15409511053134 is BIT-IDENTICAL to the champion, so the entire increment is stage 6. NOT PROMOTABLE, for two reasons that are both about the variant and neither about the mechanism: (1) MICRONS IS RUNTIME-BLOCKED - the stage costs ~1075 s and the champion already runs 3398-3418 s against a 3450 s guard deadline, so _RECLAIM_ROUNDS['microns']=0 ships and microns was not run; that is P07, now holding its largest piece of evidence (+0.018759 pp, 9.4x the bar, uncollectable for want of seconds). (2) THE MOUSE LEG IS BUILT ON THE WRONG BASE - H59 sits on H42 but the mouse champion is H52, so it scored 92.94798739 = -0.154839 pp vs H52; it clears the -0.26 non-inferiority margin and THAT PASS IS NOT CLAIMED (that is exactly P04's mis-specification). TWO RESULTS THAT OUTLIVE THE ITEM. (a) M12 IS NARROWED BY MEASUREMENT: the prototype predicted the screen to +0.000062 pp (0.35% relative), the first prototype number in this campaign to transfer. M12's bias needs the variant to diverge upstream, which a TERMINAL appended stage never does - so a from-champion prototype is a biased screening number for an inner-stage change and a genuine PREDICTION for a pure append. Amended in killed.json. (b) NEW ITEM P14: variants are built on ONE pipeline while sota.json has a champion PER DATASET (H42/H42/H52), and cycle 13 made the same mistake unnoticed - H60's mouse runs were compared to the H42 value, not to the H52 champion. sota.json UNTOUCHED; no score moved. NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
